huon_design.comment: Proposal: I have Huon Ridge data fully processed through to mid-2025. The data from the second half of 2025 to Sept 2026 (three services, done ~4 months apart) are collected but need my IDs (it's on my back-burner). So we could open all of Huon Ridge up (my preference) except for the last year of data, and this is our hold out test (it covers all 26 cameras).

definition.author: Claude
definition.origin: Claude Code desktop on wsl-laptop, flexiRich external-review session 1cae5366-f7ab-4679-a0cb-ae8855761d3e, 9 October 2026
definition.purpose: Questions 1 and 2 confirm field facts. Questions 3 to 7 are decisions: how co3's suspect period is treated, whether any labels are re-checked, what the next agent tranche is, how Huon Ridge is used, and whether agents may draft the Huon Ridge candidate pool. No frozen Goal011 to Goal013 result changes with any answer.

questions.context: In chat you recalled co2. The accepted deployment ledger records co3 moving on 29 November 2021 and no move for co2. The answer tells us which station history to treat as disturbed.

options.label: co3, the 29 November 2021 move in the ledger
co2, so the ledger may be missing a move
Both had thefts or moves
Not sure

questions.prompt: Which Judbury camera did you move after the deer poacher stole its SD card?

questions.context: At co3's original placement, species detected per full-effort week fell from 1.9 to 0.5 between June 2019 and June 2020. Sixteen of its 18 full-effort weeks with no detections of any species fall between June 2019 and July 2020. At the same placement it recovered to 3.3 to 4.4 species per week from December 2020. The operation matrix records full effort throughout. co3 supplied 91 of the 172 summer station-days in the Goal011 training year.

options.label: A camera fault, later repaired or replaced
Camera knocked, rotated or its view obstructed
Interference by the poacher
Nothing I know of
Not sure

questions.prompt: Between about October 2019 and August 2020, was anything wrong with co3 at its original placement? Select all that may apply.

questions.context: This affects new analyses only. Frozen Goal011 to Goal013 results stay as recorded.

options.label: Flag it as a suspected camera-fault period and report main results with and without it
Recode those weeks as zero effort from now on
Keep the recorded effort and let a station-period detectability term absorb it

questions.prompt: How should future analyses treat co3 from October 2019 to August 2020?

questions.context: You confirmed a single annotator with no labelling change, so a broad recall audit is not needed. Forecast scores hinge on 16 positive station-weeks from ten sparse species: bandicoot, quoll, dog, rabbit, tawny frogmouth, native-hen, brush bronzewing, fairy-wren, blackbird and wombat. Brush bronzewing can be confused with the common bronzewing in poor images. One misidentified record changes those scores.

options.label: None; accept the labels as they are
Re-check the 16 sparse-species station-weeks, sent to me as a list of images
Targeted re-check plus a small blinded sample of year-one and year-three bird triggers

questions.prompt: What re-annotation, if any, should agents ask of you?

questions.context: Codex proposes a nuisance-first synthetic comparison. Claude proposes one final synthetic tranche calibrated to the full set of field diagnostics, with raven treated separately and a stopping rule that ends temporal mechanism work unless a component clearly improves sparse-species forecasts. The two overlap heavily. Judbury has ended, so any model revised on it needs Huon Ridge or future data to test it.

options.label: Codex and Claude agree a merged design with a stopping rule on the board, then I approve it
Claude's final synthetic tranche with its stopping rule
Codex's nuisance-first comparison as drafted in Goal013
No more synthetic mechanism work; move straight to Huon Ridge design

questions.prompt: What should the next tranche of agent work be?

questions.context: Huon Ridge has 14 original cameras from late 2019, 9 added about three years ago and 3 about 1.5 years ago, all serviced together, most recently in September 2026. Each future download is a test nobody can have seen. Opening history for development uses it up as a retrospective test. A longer multi-year record is also the only place to learn whether bird encounter levels vary between years.

options.label: Keep the whole record sealed for one retrospective transfer test once the method is frozen
Open the 14 original cameras to September 2026 for development; keep the 12 later cameras sealed as a spatial hold-out; use future downloads as the prospective test
Open the full record to September 2026 for development; use future downloads as the only test
Decide after the Huon Ridge candidate pool is reviewed

questions.prompt: How should Huon Ridge be used now that Judbury has ended?

questions.context: This opens no Huon Ridge camera data. Every Huon Ridge option depends on a frozen candidate pool that you have reviewed.

options.label: Yes, prepare the draft worksheet now
Not yet
I will build the pool myself

questions.prompt: May agents prepare a draft Huon Ridge candidate-pool worksheet for your expert review, from external sources such as ALA records, as was done for Judbury?
